text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Ah-wa-wa-wa! I-I'm, with Opera O-san... Ah-wa-wa-wa!

An unexpected, fierce struggle. Panicking mid-race,
Meisho Doto pulled off a victory against
TM Opera O.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Gwooooh, what a twist! To outshine me on the very stage where I was meant to sparkle!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
O unexpected assassin! O thwarter of the coronation!
What is thy name—?!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Oho, so you're called Hawawawa?
Curse you, Great King Hawawawa!

Having no leeway to play along with T.M. Opera O's
theatrics, they were purely in a frantic panic.

"...Praising her a little made her panic again.
I need to proceed carefully here..."

Afterward, she was carried in as usual, but
it was nothing serious. While the result was good,
giving it her all in her current body still seemed too taxing.
